title: 10 Things a Godly Man Stops Saying When a Brother Confesses
caption:
It took him months to say it out loud. What you say in the next ten seconds decides whether he ever says anything again.

Most of us mean well and still get it wrong. We make it about us, shrink it, lecture him, or go quiet and change the subject.

A godly brother does the harder thing. He listens, he takes it seriously, he points to grace, and he shows up on Friday like he said he would.

"Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ." Galatians 6:2

Save this. Be the man a brother can tell.
